positions.name: RollbackRehearsalCadence
positions.frame: how does rehearsal cadence establish whether a rollback is actually in hand?
positions.why: src-1 is Quinton Fairweather's commissive decision that Atlas rollback rehearsals run monthly, grounded in the principle that an unrehearsed rollback is not one you actually have. src-2 is the assertive summary recording that decision — monthly cadence, Quinton as owner. Both expressions cohere under the same directional read: the question of how a regular rehearsal schedule constitutes proof of rollback preparedness. The set holds no internal tension; the summary restates the decision.
